title: Last Dev crash at start
symptom: Last dev crash systematically at start. Clean install did not help. User is on Samsung s10e Android 12 One UI 4.1 with Omnipod Dash. Crash appears with the last update for Dash.
cause: The crash was caused by the Wear module not being updated, leading to crashes at start. The Dash pod state deserialization error was not the cause.
fix: Disable the Wear module or update the Wear app to match the main app version. After updating Wear, the issue was resolved.
evidence_quote: Crashs were cause by the wear module not by dash.
